content:
marta: Heads-up: opening PR to reorganize the private/VPC install docs. Main goals: consolidate the KMS/HSM firewall guidance, add an explicit mgmt-subnet recommendation, and include a concise nftables example for air-gapped installs. Need quick reviews on wording and one more eyes-on for the PKCS#11 link.

cheng: I'll skim now. Can we keep the port matrix row for the HSM admin port (TCP 6010) in the main table but add a note that its optional if HSM is managed through a bastion?

marta: Good call. I kept the row but added a parenthetical and cross-ref to the bastion section.

sam: Noted a broken external link to the PKCS11 draft. I'll swap to the IETF archive URL. Also suggested trimming the HSM creds example so we don't include a real-looking OAuth token in the snippet.

priya: For nftables: prefer using conntrack primitives to avoid accidental passthrough for established returns. Proposed snippet in PR: 

```
# nftables: allow nodes in mgmt subnet to reach KMS (443)
nft add table inet redwood
nft add chain inet redwood forward { type filter hook forward priority 0; }
nft add rule inet redwood forward ip saddr 10.10.0.0/24 tcp dport 443 ct state new,established accept
nft add rule inet redwood forward ct state established,related accept
```

cheng: That looks fine. Small nit: the table/chain creation commands may already exist in a live system; maybe wrap with 'add table || create' comment to avoid failures.

infra-ops: Confirmed mgmt-subnet approach. We prefer firewall rules scoped to the management CIDR and avoid node IP allowances. Also: if HSM vendor requires TLS mutual auth on different port, note it in the appendix (we added 9010 as example).

marta: Thanks. Ill add a one-line fail-safe: "If table/chain exist the commands are idempotent in most distro nft versions" and link to distro caveat.

docs-ci-bot: Link check: 1 broken external URL (PKCS11). Spellcheck: OK. Markdown lint: 2 warnings (heading levels).

sam: Pushed fix for PKCS11 and tightened HSM example. Also replaced the pseudo-token with an env var placeholder.

priya: LGTM for nftables snippet. One more request: add a tiny troubleshooting note about iptables-nft compatibility, e.g., 'on systems with legacy iptables frontends, nft commands may map differently'.

marta: Added troubleshooting note and bumped changelog entry: "Clarify HSM firewall guidance and add nftables snippet for mgmt subnet".

cheng: +1 from me.

infra-ops: +1. Well add a link to vendor HSM port guidance in the appendix in a follow-up if needed.

marta: Plan: merge after docs-ci passes clean. If any objection, speak now; otherwise merging tomorrow morning and I'll drop a blurb in #support so oncall sees the change.

sam: No objections.

docs-ci-bot: CI passed on second run.

marta: Merged. Will follow up with vendor appendix if infra flags anything else.
